content.intent: Fixing truncation in to_cents and rerunning tests

content.text:
The bug was in `to_cents` in `ledger/currency.py`. It used `int(amount * 100)`, which truncates. Float error turned 19.99 into 1998.999… and that became 1998. I changed it to `round(amount * 100)`.

All 5 tests now pass, including the ones in `tests/test_report.py`. I ran the whole suite, not only `tests/test_totals.py`.
